crossRefs.note: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of…
For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good…
For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those…
They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many…
The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever: yet have you brought up my life from the…
As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no…
whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.
and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.”
crossRefs.keyword: horrible pit. Heb. pit of noise

crossRefs.note: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep…
Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…
They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will…
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
“Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house…
The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded…
My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

translations.web: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
translations.bsb: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
translations.kjv: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
translations.asv: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay; And he set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
